A '''Human male''' with a frizzy [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|beard]] was part of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Like other members of the Council, this man was in charge of a specific ministry, and his task was to assist the queen in her rule.<ref name="E1:IG" /> He was in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] during a meeting between [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] and the Council immediately prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This councilman was one of the many background characters seen in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first movie of the ''Star Wars'' [[prequel trilogy]]. Like many others, he was portrayed by an unknown extra.<ref name="TPM" />

This character is one of the only two members of the Royal Advisory Council that are still unnamed in [[canon]]. It should also be noted that, while their peers were seating around Queen Amidala, the bearded councilor and his [[Unidentified Naboo councilwoman (32 BBY)|unidentified colleague]] were standing in the room.<ref name="TPM" />
